correctness.rationale: Delete center c to obtain X, let L be its simplicial link. The independent-set dichotomy gives α(S∪{c})=max(α(S),1+# distal selected), so non-link faces contain precisely k−1 distal d_i; any outside-branch vertex violates independence cap. For each I of size k−1, the closed star of distal face is simplicially Δ^{k−2}*(S⁰)^{*(k−1)}, a (2k−3)-ball; its intersection with L is its whole sphere boundary, and different interiors intersect only in L. Geometric pushout X∪(c*L) is homotopy cofiber X/L; collapsing L gives exactly binom(m,k−1) spheres with integral homotopy type. If m<k−1, X=L so whole complex is a cone. Independently enumerated exact faces and nonlink stars for m=1..4, k∈{4,5}; this is corroboration of universal topological proof.

value.rationale: The family is the simplest high-k robust-clique square cactus outside edge-glued sequences, giving full integral homotopy types and a sharp contractibility boundary for unbounded m,k.
